description.en: Link two CRM contacts with a typed relation such as parent, child, spouse, sibling, friend, manager, report, colleague, partner, client, supplier, referrer, or referral. Use it to build family trees, personal networks, company org charts, business relationships, and referral chains. Adding the inverse of an existing relation reuses the same link instead of creating a duplicate.

warp.bot: Use this to record how a contact is connected to another contact. Pass the contact's ID as contactId and the other person's ID as relatedContactId. The relation is read from the first contact's point of view: 'parent_of' means contactId is the parent of relatedContactId, 'referred_by' means relatedContactId referred contactId. If the user refers to a person by name, list contacts first to find the matching ID.

inputs.bot: Family: parent_of, child_of, spouse_of, sibling_of, aunt_of (this contact is the aunt/uncle), nibling_of (this contact is the niece/nephew). Personal/Social: friend_of (personal friends, not business partner_of). Organization: manages, reports_to, colleague_of. Business: partner_of (business partner, not friend_of), client_of, supplier_of. Referral: referred_by (the other contact referred this one), referred (this contact referred the other). en: Record that one contact is the parent, child, or spouse of another for a family tree
Model a company structure by linking managers to their direct reports
Track business partners, clients, and suppliers between contacts
Capture referral chains so you can see who brought in whom
de: Festhalten, dass ein Kontakt Elternteil, Kind oder Ehepartner eines anderen ist, für einen Stammbaum
Eine Unternehmensstruktur abbilden, indem du Vorgesetzte mit ihren Mitarbeitenden verknüpfst

en.question: What relation types are supported?
en.answer: Family (parent_of, child_of, spouse_of, sibling_of, aunt_of, nibling_of), personal/social (friend_of — personal friendship, not business partner_of), organization (manages, reports_to, colleague_of), business (partner_of, client_of, supplier_of), and referral (referred_by, referred). Symmetric types include spouse_of, sibling_of, colleague_of, partner_of, and friend_of.

en.question: Can I add both directions of a relationship?
en.answer: You only need to add it once. Adding the inverse of an existing relation reuses the same link instead of creating a duplicate.

en.question: Can I link contacts from different teams?
en.answer: No. Both contacts must belong to the same team.

de.question: Welche Beziehungstypen werden unterstützt?
de.answer: Familie (parent_of, child_of, spouse_of, sibling_of, aunt_of, nibling_of), persönlich/sozial (friend_of — persönliche Freundschaft, nicht Geschäftspartner partner_of), Organisation (manages, reports_to, colleague_of), Geschäft (partner_of, client_of, supplier_of) und Empfehlung (referred_by, referred). Symmetrische Typen sind u. a. spouse_of, sibling_of, colleague_of, partner_of und friend_of.

de.question: Muss ich beide Richtungen einer Beziehung erfassen?
de.answer: Nein, einmal genügt. Die Gegenrichtung einer bestehenden Beziehung verwendet dieselbe Verknüpfung statt ein Duplikat anzulegen.

de.question: Kann ich Kontakte aus verschiedenen Teams verknüpfen?
de.answer: Nein. Beide Kontakte müssen zum selben Team gehören.

en.question: Can I change the relation type?
en.answer: Yes. Pass a new type and the relation is re-pointed automatically; it is rejected if that relation already exists.

en.question: Can I remove a note?
en.answer: Yes. Send an empty string as the note to clear it.

de.question: Kann ich den Beziehungstyp ändern?
de.answer: Ja. Übergib einen neuen Typ, und die Beziehung wird automatisch neu ausgerichtet; sie wird abgelehnt, wenn diese Beziehung bereits existiert.

de.question: Kann ich eine Notiz entfernen?
de.answer: Ja. Sende einen leeren String als Notiz, um sie zu löschen.
